description: Grug agent and skills for clarity-first review, refactoring, architectural replacement, codebase explanation, plain technical writing, TypeScript, engineering principles, and Mapbox GL JS flyovers.

interface.shortDescription: Grug agent, complexity-cutting, explanation, and writing skills, Mapbox flyovers
interface.longDescription: Grug designs, implements, and reviews the smallest clear change, and cuts code that doesn't earn its keep. Uncomplect pressure-tests a stateful system through Hickey's complection, Ousterhout's deep modules, and Young's deletability. How and why explain how code works and why it is built that way, and teach combines them into a plain walkthrough. Unslop and technical-writing cut AI tells and tighten docs. Typescript-best-practices sets type-system rules for .ts files. Blast-radius proves a change is safe beyond the diff, and recall and reflect rebuild context and turn session learnings into skill edits. The principle-* skills are short engineering rules, such as fix root causes, test behavior, and make illegal states unrepresentable. Flyover turns a text description into a cinematic 3D Mapbox GL JS page.
defaultPrompt: Run a grug review on this branch
